parameters.name: Argument
parameters.description: The JVM (Java Virtual Machine) startup parameters.

parameters.name: ConfigCheckRule
parameters.description:
The configuration check rule. The value is a JSON string in the following format:

`{"deviceConfig":{"required":false},"driverConfig":{"required":false}}`

Parameter description:

- driverConfig: the configuration check rule for the driver in the edge instance.

- deviceConfig: the configuration check rule for devices under the driver in the edge instance.

If `required` is set to true, the parameter cannot be empty. If `required` is set to false, the parameter can be empty.

parameters.name: ContainerConfig
parameters.description: The container configuration. The value is a JSON string. For more information, see the ContainerConfig table below.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The driver description. The description can be up to 256 bytes in length.

parameters.name: DriverConfig
parameters.description:
The driver configuration. The value is a JSON string in the following format:

`{"format":"JSON","content":"{}"}`

Parameter description:

- format: the configuration format. Valid values: KV (key-value pair configuration), JSON (JSON format), and FILE (configuration file).
- content: the configuration content. If format is set to KV or JSON, specify the configuration content. If format is set to FILE, specify the OSS address. 

    > Call the [CreateOssPreSignedAddress](~~155858~~) operation to obtain the OSS address.

parameters.name: DriverId
parameters.description:
The driver ID. In the [IoT Platform console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), go to the **Driver Management** page and hover over the target driver name to obtain the ID.

You can also call the [QueryEdgeDriver](~~155776~~) operation to obtain the driver ID.

parameters.name: EdgeVersion
parameters.description: The edge version that the driver is adapted to. The driver can run only on gateways with this edge version or later. For example, 2.4.0 indicates that the driver runs on edge version v2.4.0 or later.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for the public instance. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances.

parameters.name: SourceConfig
parameters.description:
The source configuration of the driver code. The value is a JSON string in the following format:

`{"ossAddress":"http://***/driver_code.zip"}`

In this format, `ossAddress` is the Object Storage Service (OSS) access address. To upload driver code and obtain the OSS address by calling an API operation, call the [CreateOssPreSignedAddress](~~155858~~) operation.
